summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The PIMCO RAFI ESG U.S. ETF (RAFE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the RAFI ESG US index. The fund tracks an index of US companies that are selected and weighted by a combination of fundamental and ESG criteria. RAFE was launched on Dec 18, 2019 and is issued by PIMCO.

holdings.infoBox: RAFE is an equity ETF with a total of 294 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 5.49%, Microsoft at 5.29%, Johnson & Johnson at 3.11%, UnitedHealth Group at 2.72%, and JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 2.48%.
